declaration.preface:
Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. is committed to conducting its operations in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner while delivering high-quality Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, API pellets, and specialty chemical products to customers worldwide.

As a responsible pharmaceutical manufacturer, the Company strives to minimize the environmental impacts associated with its operations by promoting pollution prevention, efficient resource utilization, responsible waste management, energy conservation, water stewardship, and climate-conscious practices. Environmental considerations are integrated into business planning, operational decision-making, and manufacturing processes to enhance operational efficiency and support sustainable growth.
declaration.declaration:
Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. is committed to protecting the environment by integrating environmentally responsible practices into all aspects of its operations. The Company recognizes that effective environmental management is fundamental to sustainable business growth, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder confidence.

The Company is committed to preventing pollution, conserving natural resources, improving energy and water efficiency, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, managing wastes responsibly, and minimizing the environmental impacts associated with its manufacturing processes and business activities. Environmental considerations shall be incorporated into planning, decision-making, process improvements, and investment initiatives to support sustainable development.
declaration.scope: This Environmental Stewardship Policy applies to all operations, manufacturing facilities, research and development centers, warehouses, utilities, laboratories, and corporate offices of Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. under its operational control.

focusAreas: Materials Sourcing, Chemicals Safety and Waste Disposal

Energy Management and Carbon Footprint: We are committed to improving energy efficiency across our manufacturing facilities, laboratories, utilities, warehouses, and administrative offices by optimizing operational processes, enhancing equipment performance, and adopting energy-efficient technologies wherever technically and economically feasible.

We will identify, monitor, and evaluate energy consumption and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions on a periodic basis to establish performance benchmarks, support data-driven decision-making, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

We will promote employee awareness and encourage responsible energy management through regular training, communication, and engagement initiatives, fostering a culture of energy conservation and climate responsibility across the organization.
Water Stewardship: We are committed to conserving water by improving water-use efficiency across manufacturing operations, utilities, laboratories, cooling systems, and support functions through process optimization and responsible water management practices.

We will strengthen water recycling, reuse, and recovery initiatives by maintaining efficient wastewater treatment systems and exploring opportunities to maximize the utilization of treated water wherever operationally feasible.

We will enhance employee awareness on responsible water management through periodic training, awareness programs, and participation in water conservation initiatives across all operational facilities.
Product Disposal and Recycling: We are committed to promoting responsible product stewardship by considering environmental aspects throughout the product lifecycle and encouraging environmentally sound management practices where applicable.
We will engage with customers and other stakeholders to promote responsible product lifecycle management practices that support environmental protection and resource conservation.
Environmental Community Engagement: We are committed to fostering a culture of environmental responsibility by integrating environmental considerations into business planning, operational decision-making, and day-to-day activities across the organization.

We will conduct regular environmental awareness and competency-building programs for employees and contractors to strengthen understanding of environmental responsibilities, regulatory compliance, and sustainable work practices.
Air Quality Management: We are committed to minimizing air emissions from manufacturing processes, utility operations, and support activities through effective pollution control systems, process optimization, and adoption of cleaner production practices.
We will enhance employee awareness regarding air quality management, emission control measures, and environmental compliance through periodic training and operational guidance.
Product Utilization: We are committed to integrating environmental considerations into product development, manufacturing processes, and quality management practices to reduce environmental impacts while maintaining product quality, safety, and regulatory compliance.
Materials Sourcing, Chemicals Safety and: We are committed to optimizing the use of raw materials, solvents, process chemicals, and packaging materials through efficient manufacturing practices, process innovation, and continuous resource optimization.

We will promote waste minimization through source reduction, solvent recovery, recycling, reuse, and resource recovery initiatives while striving to advance circular economy principles wherever operationally feasible.
Biodiversity: We are committed to minimizing the potential impacts of our operations on biodiversity and surrounding ecosystems by integrating environmental considerations into operational planning and facility management.
Customer Health & Safety: We are committed to manufacturing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, and related products that consistently meet approved quality specifications, customer requirements, and applicable national and international regulatory standards to ensure product quality, safety, and reliability.

responsibilities.duty: Provide strategic direction and oversight for the implementation of this Policy.
Review the Company's performance, strategic objectives, and significant risks related to customer health and safety.
Promote a culture of quality, regulatory compliance, and continual improvement across the organization.
Ensure the effective implementation of the Policy throughout the organization.
Allocate adequate resources, including personnel, infrastructure, technology, and financial support, to achieve the Policy objectives.
Periodically review performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented where necessary.
Establish, implement, and maintain quality systems that ensure products consistently meet approved specifications and regulatory requirements.
Monitor compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality management requirements.
Manage product quality investigations, deviations, customer complaints, CAPA, change control, and product recall activities, where applicable.
Manufacture products in accordance with approved processes, GMP requirements, and established quality standards.
Ensure operational controls are implemented to prevent contamination, cross-contamination, and product quality deviations.
Support continual process improvements to enhance product quality, consistency, and operational efficiency.
Ensure compliance with applicable national and international pharmaceutical regulations and customer-specific requirements.
Maintain regulatory documentation, product registrations, and customer technical documentation as required.
Monitor regulatory developments and communicate changes that may impact product quality or customer requirements.
Perform assigned responsibilities in accordance with approved procedures, GMP requirements, and this Policy.
Promptly report quality concerns, product deviations, or potential risks affecting customer health and safety.
Participate in mandatory training programs and contribute to continual improvement initiatives.

policy.monitoring: Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. shall regularly monitor its environmental performance through defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), environmental inspections, compliance evaluations, operational monitoring, and internal audits. Progress against the Company's environmental objectives and quantitative targets shall be reviewed periodically to identify improvement opportunities, ensure regulatory compliance, and support effective environmental management.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Environmental Stewardship Policy shall be reviewed at least once every one years, or earlier if required due to changes in applicable legal or regulatory requirements, business operations, organizational structure, stakeholder expectations, or significant environmental risks and opportunities. Any revisions shall be approved by the appropriate management authority before implementation. The Head of Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Department, in coordination with the Management, shall be responsible for regular review of this policy.
